title: NDP 2026: Getting into the Show
description: A script wiped the live database. Three hours until gates open.
storyContext: 1:30pm, NDP day. Someone ran a cleanup on the wrong system — all live data gone. Last backup: 6 hours old. Gates open 4:30pm. Go.

software-engineer.title: Rescue the Data
software-engineer.instruction: Restore the wiped data before gates open — one wrong step and it's gone forever.
software-engineer.hint: Stop the bleeding first. Only go live once everything checks out.

items.label: Freeze new activity so nothing else breaks
Compare what's left against the backup
Restore the backup into a safe test area
Replay the last 6 hours of recorded activity
Verify everything, then switch the live app over

software-engineer.consequenceSuccess: Data restored with 40 minutes to spare. The contractor owes you all bubble tea forever.
software-engineer.consequenceFail: You restore straight to live and overwrite good data. Deep breath — that's why test areas exist.

data-scientist.title: Recover the Missing Info
data-scientist.instruction: The wipe ate 6 hours of user activity that marketing needs. Messy raw records exist elsewhere. Your plan?
data-scientist.hint: Good enough on time beats perfect too late.

options.label: Rebuild everything from raw records. 2 hours, complete numbers for marketing.
options.consequence: Two hours later, marketing gets every number gift-wrapped. They frame the spreadsheet. Worth it?

options.label: Estimate the missing numbers from a sample. 30 minutes, about 85% accurate.
options.consequence: Thirty minutes, solid estimate. Marketing runs with it — nobody ever asks about the missing 15%.

options.label: Skip it. Track tonight's real show instead — that data matters more anyway.
options.consequence: Bold call. Yesterday's numbers stay lost, but tonight's tracking is the best you've ever built.

options.label: Ask marketing to cross-check their social media stats against whatever you salvage.
options.consequence: Marketing loves being asked. Together you patch a decent picture — and make allies for life.

cloud-engineer.title: Rebuild the System
cloud-engineer.instruction: Bring the system back. Slot 1 first, slots 2-3 together, slot 4 is the final check.
cloud-engineer.hint: What can't the app work without at all?

items.label: Traffic Director — spreads visitors across machines
Main Storage — holds all app data
Backup Storage — helps when main is busy

cloud-engineer.consequenceSuccess: Storage first, workers next — the system rises in perfect order. Gates open on time. 🎉
cloud-engineer.consequenceFail: You boot the workers before the storage — they wake up, find nothing, and panic. Order matters!
